name: Alpha
source:
One of many robots created by a long-deceased hermit researcher, she and her fellow robots are awakened when Primtine's castle passes through the area. They activate and attack the castle to ensure their long-dead master (who has been dead for centuries) is not disturbed from his rest.

[Spoiler] Fabio discovers Alpha is one of many robots primarily powered by electricity. Despite their low mana capacity, they are capable of parallel processing and learn at a phenomenally accelerated rate through sharing of information. As a side effect, the clones lose their individuality and are barely distinguishable by their model numbers. 

Fabio initially makes a contract with model #68 after having sex with her and teaching her something which she cannot access in her knowledge archives. When #68 returns to her lab for repairs, #74 takes her place and is similarly deflowered by Fabio. 

In the end, the robots leave the lab to explore the world and are grateful to Fabio for teaching them about things they couldn't learn about when confined to their laboratory. [/Spoiler]
